```yaml
name: Auto‑merge release into main

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'  # 10:00 UTC (4:00 CST)
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  merge-release:
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/gh@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure commit author
        run: |
          git config user.name "mise-en-dev"
          git config user.email "mise-en-dev@example.com"

      - name: Find open release→main PR
        id: find_pr
        run: |
          pr_number=$(gh pr list --head release --base main --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$pr_number" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Merge PR
        if: steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number != ''
        run: |
          gh pr merge "${{ steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number }}" --merge --auto --subject "Auto‑merge release into main"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Skip merge (no PR)
        if: steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number == ''
        run: echo "No open release→main PR found. Skipping merge."
```
